contracts: workspace.history.upsert.write write/upsert(path, now) returns committed plain row; one increment, captured caller time and receipt in the same immediate transaction; no replay on uncertain outcome.

refreshAllForPath reads sources and filesystem on main, disables user config and orphan pruning for this path, snapshots plain import data; commitImport delegates existing tool_defaults.transition apply with imports/sources mutation and no explicit edits.
tool_defaults.transition commits registry and canonical defaults atomically in its existing worker; imported defaults remain disabled; no filesystem or event callback is supplied to its transaction.
workspace.add publishes mcp.registry.changed only for nonzero committed import counts; scan failure retains history success; response remains the enriched history read after scan.
